Question: Assalamalaikum brother i am sending this question from saudi arab.. here i find mostly islamic institues called dawah centres all the ulemas are ahle hadees.they always critisize deobandis and openly they say that they are kafirs nauzbillah.. they show the fazaile aamal of hazrat zakriya sahab and say that its full of kufr written.. and say there is no authentic ahadees available in this book. and in their bayans they take video's saying that it is allowed for islamic dawah and haram for personel use. how exacactly is this correct can you please send me the answer in the light of quran and ahadees. allahhafiz Answer ID: 5090 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 352/352=M/1429) Abusing is the habit of Ghair Muqallideen. You should not get disheartened. If they blaspheme Deobandis and labell them with kufr (infidelity) them for being Muqallid , what would they say about those great Muhaddisin and Imams of Hadith who were Shafe?i or Hanbali? Were they also kafir ? ( نعوذ باللہ ) You should ask those Ghair Muqallideen Ulama to identify what things of kufr are there in Fazail-e-Aamal and by which Hadith the kufr is proved? You should ask them which Haidh allows making video of speeches and orations. Send whatever they would reply to these questions and ask the question again. Then, in-sha-Allah you will be replied with details along with proofs. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
